gen3.UI_ALERT_PERSISTENT_RELOCALIZATION_FAIL: Floor Plan Navigation Error. Ensure that the charge base has not moved. Place the robot on the base and try again. If the problem persists, go to My Floor Plan, remove the current floor plan and create a new one.

gen3.UI_ALERT_MULTIPLE_FLOORPLANS_VALID: This floor looks too similar to another floor plan. Please remove any new objects that may have been placed near the charge base and try again. If this problem persists, please remove the floor plan for this floor, move the base to a new location, and create a new floor plan.
gen3.UI_ALERT_PM_LOAD_FAIL: Floor Plan Loading Error. Please try cleaning again. If the problem persists, please contact customer support.
gen3.UI_ALERT_NAV_FLOORPLAN_NOT_CREATED: Floor Plan Not Created. To create a floor plan, the robot must complete a cleaning run and return to the base. Please try again.
gen3.UI_ALERT_NAV_FLOORPLAN_ZONE_UNREACHABLE: Path Blocked. The robot can not clean the zone since its path is blocked. Please check if any doors were closed or remove any objects or No-Go Lines that are in the way and try again.
gen3.UI_ALERT_NAV_FLOORPLAN_ZONE_WRONG_FLOOR: Wrong Floor. The robot can not clean the zone since it is located on a different floor. Please place the robot on the correct floor and try again.
gen3.UI_ALERT_TRAINING_MAP_SPARSE: Area Too Sparse. The robot cannot distinguish this area. Please move the charge base to another location on this floor and try again.
